title: VSift candidates JSON Lines terminal data v1
description: The data member of the complete or partial terminal result that ends a candidates --events jsonl stream (P08). It is the page of candidates-data.schema.json without its items: the candidates were the preceding evidence events (record_type visual_candidate), in time order, and record_count says how many there were. Pass next_cursor back with the same session and range to stream the next page; null means the range is exhausted.
